New York Mets at Washington Nationals

headlines.description: — Andrés Chaparro homered twice and the Washington Nationals defeated the New York Mets 6-4 on Sunday in the season finale for both teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Andrés Chaparro's 2-homer game lifts Nationals over Mets 6-4 in season finale

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Philadelphia Phillies

headlines.description: — Bryce Harper and Edmundo Sosa homered, and Zack Wheeler delivered like a Game 7 ace to bring the Philadelphia Phillies back from the brink of collapse and
headlines.shortLinkText: Phillies clinch NL wild card behind Wheeler for 5th straight playoff appearance with win over Rays

events.name: Chicago Cubs at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Alex Bregman went 4 for 4 with two home runs and four RBI in his second game back from a frightening injury, and the Chicago Cubs beat the Boston...
headlines.shortLinkText: Alex Bregman's huge day at the plate in relocated season finale powers Cubs to 6-2 win over Red Sox

headlines.description: — The Houston Astros won their fifth AL West title in six years despite finishing with the worst record for a first-place team, beating the Athletics 9-0 Sunday behind Lucas Spence’s two-run triple to finish at 81-81.
headlines.shortLinkText: Astros win AL West with 81-81 record, worst for first-place team, beat A's 9-0

events.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Alex Call hit a run-scoring double with two outs in the 10th inning and Andy Pages added a three-run homer as the Los Angeles Dodgers ended their season with their 100th victory, a 5-1 decision over the San Francisco Giants on Sunday that completed...
headlines.shortLinkText: Call's RBI double, Pages' 3-run HR in 10th lift Dodgers to win No. 100, 5-1 over Giants

events.name: Cincinnati Reds at Toronto Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Max Scherzer struck out seven over seven-plus innings for his 225th career win, Brandon Valenzuela and Charles McAdoo homered and the Toronto Blue Jays beat the Cincinnati Reds 5-1 in Sunday’s season finale.
headlines.shortLinkText: Max Scherzer strikes out 7 in 225th career win as Blue Jays beat Reds 5-1 in season finale

headlines.description: — Major league-innings leader Sandy Alcantara got his third save, Heriberto Hernández and Griffin Conine homered and the Miami Marlins beat the the playoff-bound Atlanta Braves 5-3 in Sunday's regular-season finale.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alcantara gets another save, Hernández, Conine homer as Marlins beat playoff-bound Braves 5-3

headlines.description: — Konnor Griffin homered and the Pittsburgh Pirates recorded their first winning season in eight years with a 4-2 victory over the Detroit Tigers on Sunday in the final game for both teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Griffin's homer helps Pirates finish with winning record, beating Detroit 4-2

events.name: Cleveland Guardians at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Vinnie Pasquantino homered twice and the Kansas City Royals snapped a three-game skid with a 3-2 victory over the Cleveland Guardians on Sunday in the regular-season finale for both teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Royals snap 3-game skid, beat AL Central champion Guardians 3-2 in regular-season finale

events.name: Colorado Rockies at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Randal Grichuk and Brenton Doyle homered in Chicago’s four-run third inning, powering the playoff-bound White Sox over the Colorado Rockies 4-2 in Sunday's regular-season finale.
headlines.shortLinkText: Grichuk and Doyle go deep in 3rd, power playoff-bound White Sox past Rockies 4-2 in season finale

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Milwaukee Brewers

headlines.description: — Jacob Misiorowski allowed two hits in 5 1/3 shutout innings to cap his brilliant season as the Milwaukee Brewers defeated the St. Louis Cardinals 6-4 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Misiorowski continues Cy Young Award push and Turang gets 100th RBI as Brewers beat Cardinals 6-4

headlines.description: — The Texas Rangers were eliminated from postseason contention on the final day of the regular season with a 6-4 loss Sunday to the Minnesota Twins, who got a home run and three RBI from Josh Bell to back Dean Kremer's seven innings of one-run pitching.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rangers eliminated from postseason contention on final day with 6-4 loss to Twins

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Seattle Mariners

headlines.description: — Logan Gilbert struck out eight in four no-hit innings and five Seattle pitchers combined for 12 strikeouts as the Mariners beat the Los Angeles Angels 7-3 in the regular-season finale for both teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mariners strike out 12 in 7-3 win over the Angels, announce Wilson will not return as manager

events.name: Arizona Diamondbacks at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — The Arizona Diamondbacks missed the playoffs for the eighth time in nine seasons, losing 9-4 Sunday to the postseason-bound San Diego Padres shortly after
headlines.shortLinkText: Diamondbacks miss playoffs on season's final day, losing 9-4 to Padres after Phillies clinch
